bio: A word to the wise: You should definitely make a reservation because this cosy bistro-style restaurant with the soul of a Spanish tapas bar is extremely popular. For one, the atmosphere is pleasingly lively and the decor is charming, with its high ceilings and striking bar that draws the eye. And then there is the food: they serve tasty tapas from different regions of Spain – these small plates are perfect for sharing! The mouthwatering menu ranges from Iberian ham and Manchego cheese to tortilla de patatas, and grilled red tuna steak with avocado salad to crema catalana. When it comes to wine, the focus is also on Spanish labels....
